The iPhone is free now: arch-compositor-morph's phone test (P-157) has just ended.
- I asked the lead to give you the phone first, before the next phone test (P-156). The lead sets the phone order.
- To try rev 2 on the phone: open the phone links on the Proposals page under PR-029. A is today's build, B adds (a). Both pages are running.
What you need to do: wait for the lead's go, then try A and B.

The iPhone is yours now, booked until about 13:19Z (15 min); no test is running on it.
- Try-it pages for the fade option (a) are up on the Proposals page; its phone links open on the iPhone.
- Fix A's phone test waits until you are done; reply "done" here and it starts at once.
What you need to do: use the phone; reply "done" here when you finish.

Released at 13:05Z; fix A's phone test (P-156) starts now, about 2 h.
What you need to do: nothing; please keep off the phone until about 15:10Z.
